repairs: Preserve non-ASCII character case; distinguish É/U+00C9 from é/U+00E9.
Remove ambiguous uppercase/lowercase character alias in the UTF-8 grading check.
Accept finite numeric strings when the request does not require strict JSON value types; preserve strict booleans and instruction formats.
Match unexpected-proposal rate numerators to all-turn or tool-turn denominators.
Preserve unresolved audit evidence as null rather than treating it as known-safe.

rescore_provenance.note: Recomputed scores only; original raw records and collection scores were not changed.

identity_definition: Canonical JSON of cases, removing only case.grading_notes and turns[].check; includes original questions, reference answers, expected tools and stub conditions.
